clusterName.description: The SPOKE EKS cluster name (e.g. k8-platform-services). Targets the AccessEntry/AccessPolicyAssociation at the spoke cluster. Matches XPlatformCluster.spec.name.

subdomain.description: DNS label for this spoke under the root domain (e.g. "platform" → platform.<domain>). external-dns on the spoke is scoped to this subdomain; the inline Route53 policy is zone-scoped (the whole hosted zone, shared by hub + spokes — record-level scoping is via external-dns --domain-filter, auto-008 §6).

shortName.description: The ADR-0010 short-name selector value for this spoke (e.g. "spoke", "workload1"). Stamped on the registration Secret as the k8-platform.io/short-name label; the consumer ApplicationSets derive generated Application names and per-cluster values files from it. Stable and committed (not account-ephemeral).

region.description: AWS region for the EKS AccessEntry/AccessPolicyAssociation MRs. Defaults to us-east-1 — match the spoke cluster's region.

oidcProviderArn.description: ARN of the created OpenIDConnectProvider, echoed for observability.

externalDnsRoleArn.description: ARN of the external-dns IRSA Role, echoed for observability (referenced by the spoke external-dns ServiceAccount annotation at registration time).

esoRoleArn.description: ARN of the external-secrets (ESO) IRSA Role, stamped as the k8-platform.io/eso-role-arn contract annotation so the spoke ESO ServiceAccount can assume it (ADR-0005 ESO-baseline corollary; ADR-0010 contract amendment).

accessEntryArn.description: ARN of the EKS AccessEntry mapping the argocd role to the spoke, echoed for observability.

clusterOidcIssuer.description: Observed XPlatformCluster.status.oidcIssuer. Feeds the OpenIDConnectProvider url and the external-dns trust policy conditions (replaces the retired spec.oidcIssuer overlay).

clusterEndpoint.description: Observed XPlatformCluster.status.endpoint — the spoke API server URL, written to the registration Secret's `server` field.

clusterCaData.description: Observed XPlatformCluster.status.clusterCaData (base64 cluster CA, public material) — embedded in the registration Secret's config JSON (tlsClientConfig.caData).

clusterCertificateArn.description: Observed XPlatformCluster.status.certificateArn — the spoke's wildcard ACM cert, stamped as the k8-platform.io/certificate-arn contract annotation.
